'''Bedd''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] during the [[Galactic War|renewed war]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Serving under [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Bartaph]], he and [[Bedd's unit|his unit]] were sent to reinforce the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]] in stopping [[Executor (Sith Empire rank)|Executor]] [[Krannus]] from destroying [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]].
